subject: System Design
title: How YouTube Handles Video at Scale
description: A fast breakdown of How YouTube Handles Video at Scale for builders.

hook.text: 500 hours of video are uploaded to YouTube every minute. Storing and serving that is an engineering marvel.

buildup.text: Each video is transcoded into dozens of formats and resolutions for different devices and speeds.

discovery.text: Videos are stored in Google's distributed file system and served from CDN edge caches worldwide.

twist.text: Adaptive bitrate streaming adjusts quality in real time based on your connection speed.

climax.text: YouTube's scale is staggering: over 1 billion hours watched daily across every country on Earth.

punchline.text: A billion hours daily, streamed without buffering.

quiz.question: What is adaptive bitrate streaming?
options: Adjusting video quality in real time based on connection speed
Streaming at the highest quality always
